title: arceuthobium gracile
intro: Arceuthobium gracile, commonly known as dwarf mistletoe, is a parasitic plant species that grows on various tree species. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Arceuthobium gracile are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
